name: B10-0526/2025 (PfE) – Escalating repression of the Baha’is in Iran
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalating repression of the Baha’is in Iran
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly criticises Iran for treating its Bahá'í religious minority badly. It says Bahá'ís face arrests, destroyed cemeteries, denied burials, unfair trials and surveillance, and that this got worse in 2025. The Parliament asks Iran to stop all religious discrimination, free every Bahá'í jailed just for their faith, and give Bahá'ís equal access to education, jobs and basic services. It also criticises Iran's courts for using vague charges to punish peaceful Bahá'í practice. This is an opinion; it does not change any law.

- The Parliament condemns Iran's treatment of Bahá'ís and demands it stop; nothing changes in law.
- It affects Iran's Bahá'í minority, about 300,000 people facing arrests and exclusion.
- The resolution is sent to the European Union's foreign policy chief, the Council, the Commission, the United Nations and Iran's government.
